description: This source file defines a static class 'ServicesConfiguration' that provides an extension method to configure and register various service dependencies within a Dependency Injection container for a Blazor web application. The method registers multiple scoped services related to catalog data and item services, including decorators for caching, to the service collection.

classes.name: ServicesConfiguration
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure service dependencies for the Blazor Admin project.

methods.name: AddBlazorServices
methods.description: An extension method for IServiceCollection that registers catalog and item services with their respective implementations, including caching decorators, with a scoped lifetime.
